explication: Rogue is an agent evaluation and red-teaming platform, exposed through a server, web UI, TUI, and CLI. A principal workflow configures policy scenarios or a security scan, runs tests against an agent, then presents results and reports. The graph preserves both evaluation and adversarial-testing stages, plus scenario generation and API access. Some links are documented capabilities rather than inspected call sites; these use README evidence. Unsampled subsystems are represented by exact enclosing directories where appropriate.
